listing.name: San Francisco Rush 2049 (San Francisco Rush 2049: Recompiled)
listing.summary: A San Francisco Rush 2049 N64 port, separate from ProjectR’s arcade game and the Dreamcast edition. The project reports Windows race, ghost, stunt and battle modes. Windows/Linux x86-64 RT64 packages and a WebGPU browser route are documented, with Linux-specific limits and full hardware/game coverage still unconfirmed. Use your own supported N64 ROM. Exact accepted revision/hashes and BIOS/firmware requirements are unconfirmed. You and the project manage setup and updates; Portcove has not qualified a release package or confirmed setup or gameplay.
